<thought>Using the ESI‑MS spectrum, the most intense ion is at m/z 182.073 which corresponds to the [M+H]⁺ ion. Subtracting the mass of a proton gives a neutral exact mass of ≈181.066 Da. Applying the nitrogen rule (odd nominal mass → odd number of nitrogens) and fitting the exact mass with common organic elements (C, H, O, N) yields the formula C₉H₁₁NO₃ (exact mass 181.0739 Da), which matches the observed mass within typical instrument tolerance and is consistent with the observed isotopic distribution.</thought>
<final_answer>C9H11O3N</final_answer>
